methods.instruction: Run `command` with the bash tool as {"command": <command>, "notify": "^\\{\"event\"", "timeout": 0}: it runs as a background job and every stdout line of the monitor comes to you in a notice. If the new run stops with already_running, cancel the earlier job the same way and run `command` again.

channels.about: Zavod: the host delivers the event as a letter to the agent's own address.
channels.source: Zavod CLI: ZAVOD_ME is the agent's address (a UUID equal to ZAVOD_AGENT_ID), ZAVOD_AGENT_ENGINE_ID its engine, ZAVOD_AGENT_ROOT_PID, ZAVOD_AGENT_ROOT_START and ZAVOD_AGENT_ROOT_BOOT_ID the life of its root process (the pid, field 22 of /proc/<pid>/stat and the boot id of the system); the CLI is zavod in PATH or ~/.local/bin/zavod; `zavod --json send <address> --text-file -` takes the body on stdin (a text argument is refused) and prints one JSON envelope with the top-level fields exit_code and code (checked with a refused call: exit_code 11, code letter_too_large, 'nothing was accepted'); exit 0 accepted, 10 partial effect, 11 refused (code caller_not_in_roster: the caller's address is no live agent; code letter_too_large: the body is over 65536 bytes), 12 no connection (nothing sent), 13 unknown outcome, 14 protocol error; a letter holds at most 10000 characters; `zavod --json version` sends nothing; Linux and other POSIX systems only.

channels.about: tmux: the event is pasted into the agent's pane from a buffer of its own, then Enter is sent; blind, without a receipt of the turn.
channels.source: github.com/tmux/tmux dace7f5 (3.8): cmd-load-buffer.c#cmd_load_buffer_exec (load-buffer -b <name> - reads the buffer from the client's stdin; a read or buffer error fails the command, and nothing is pasted); cmd-paste-buffer.c#cmd_paste_buffer_exec (paste-buffer -b <name> -t <pane> writes the buffer into the pane, -p with the bracketed-paste codes when the application in the pane asked for them, -d deletes the buffer; exit 0 only says the bytes were written, never that a turn began); cmd-set-buffer.c (delete-buffer -b <name>); cmd-send-keys.c#cmd_send_keys_exec (send-keys -t <pane> Enter); cmd-display-message.c (display-message -p -t <pane> '#{pane_pid}' prints the PID of the pane's process, an empty line for a pane that is not found); cmd-new-session.c (has-session -t <pane> exits 0 only when the pane's session exists). TMUX_PANE is the pane of the process, TMUX the server's socket with its pid and session: one pane id under two servers is two panes. A buffer of its own on every delivery keeps two monitors from pasting each other's text. Claude Squad runs its agents in plain tmux sessions (claudesquad_*) without variables of its own: the same record. Linux and macOS; on Windows only under Cygwin or WSL.

addressee.limitation: tmux reports no turn: exit 0 of the paste and of Enter only says the bytes were written into the pane.
